candidate.name: intraday_close_frontier_innovation_share_238p
candidate.mechanism: fraction of within-half close positions that strictly expand the preceding running close frontier
candidate.formula: For each 120-close half, count j=1..119 when c_j>max(c_0..c_(j-1)) or c_j<min(c_0..c_(j-1)); sum both half-session counts and divide by 238.
candidate.strict_tie_rule: A close exactly equal to the preceding running minimum or maximum is not an innovation.

semantic_invariance_checks.intervention: Multiply every selected close by one common strictly positive constant.
semantic_invariance_checks.campaign083_result: unchanged because only strict running-order comparisons are used
semantic_invariance_checks.distinguishes_from: nominal-price affordability and any absolute price-level factor

semantic_invariance_checks.intervention: Apply any common strictly increasing transformation to all 240 closes without creating or removing exact equalities.
semantic_invariance_checks.campaign083_result: unchanged because the complete record-innovation indicator sequence is preserved
semantic_invariance_checks.distinguishes_from: signed path efficiency, breakout magnitude, chord deviation, realized variation, and close-range occupancy

semantic_invariance_checks.intervention: Change a nonrecord close to a different nonrecord value that remains inside the preceding and later running frontier.
semantic_invariance_checks.distinguishes_from: ordinary price-update share, return entropy, spectral shape, serial correlation, variance ratio, and path travel

semantic_invariance_checks.intervention: Increase the magnitude of an existing strict record break without changing which positions are records.
semantic_invariance_checks.distinguishes_from: range-frontier expansion, prior-range breakout pressure, signed path efficiency, and extreme-shock magnitude

semantic_invariance_checks.intervention: Reflect every close path vertically around a fixed log-price level while preserving exact equality structure.
semantic_invariance_checks.campaign083_result: unchanged because new highs and new lows exchange labels but the union count is preserved
semantic_invariance_checks.distinguishes_from: terminal close location, signed path efficiency, return-sign imbalance, directional body continuity, and extreme-arrival direction

semantic_invariance_checks.intervention: Hold the complete close path fixed and change every open, high, low, volume, amount, daily, quarterly, peer, and Candidate49 field.
semantic_invariance_checks.distinguishes_from: OHLC geometry, high-low interval frontier, participation, transaction-price, market-peer, quarterly, daily, and prospective mechanisms

semantic_invariance_checks.intervention: Move an afternoon record event to the morning while preserving the total full-day sequence only through a lunch-crossing reconstruction.
semantic_invariance_checks.campaign083_result: may change because both running frontiers restart at lunch
semantic_invariance_checks.distinguishes_from: full-day terminal location and any statistic that treats 11:30 and 13:01 as adjacent

nearest_semantic_challenges.name: intraday_price_update_share_238m
nearest_semantic_challenges.relationship: both count exact close-state events on within-half adjacent positions
nearest_semantic_challenges.distinction: price-update share counts every unequal adjacent close. Campaign083 counts only a strict expansion beyond all preceding closes in that half; arbitrarily many interior updates can change the prior factor without changing Campaign083.

nearest_semantic_challenges.name: intraday_signed_path_efficiency_239m
nearest_semantic_challenges.relationship: both respond to directional close paths
nearest_semantic_challenges.distinction: signed path efficiency retains endpoint direction and magnitudes relative to total absolute travel. Campaign083 discards direction and magnitude and counts the union of strict high and low records separately by half.

nearest_semantic_challenges.name: intraday_terminal_close_location_240m
nearest_semantic_challenges.relationship: frequent one-sided records can move the terminal close toward an extreme
nearest_semantic_challenges.distinction: terminal location uses only the final close relative to the full-day close range. Campaign083 can change after an early record event even when the final close and full-day range are fixed.

nearest_semantic_challenges.name: intraday_prior_range_breakout_pressure_238p
nearest_semantic_challenges.relationship: both identify movement beyond a preceding price boundary
nearest_semantic_challenges.distinction: breakout pressure measures log distance of the current close outside only the immediately prior bar's high-low interval. Campaign083 reads no high or low, uses the complete preceding half-session close frontier, and counts events without magnitude.

nearest_semantic_challenges.name: intraday_two_sided_range_frontier_balance_238m
nearest_semantic_challenges.relationship: both update upward and downward running frontiers inside each half
nearest_semantic_challenges.distinction: the prior factor uses bar high/low boundaries and the magnitudes of fresh upward/downward expansions to score their balance. Campaign083 reads close only, ignores expansion magnitude and balance, and counts the union of strict close-frontier innovations.

nearest_semantic_challenges.name: intraday_extreme_arrival_order_240m
nearest_semantic_challenges.relationship: both use ordering of price extremes
nearest_semantic_challenges.distinction: extreme-arrival order uses the first global high and low times and their signed distance. Campaign083 resets at lunch, counts every sequential close record, and is unchanged when high/low record labels are exchanged.

nearest_semantic_challenges.name: intraday_half_session_chord_adherence_240m and intraday_close_range_occupancy_entropy_10b
nearest_semantic_challenges.distinction: chord adherence measures magnitude deviation from endpoint lines and occupancy entropy measures unordered price-bin dispersion. Campaign083 uses only sequential record-event topology and is invariant to record-break magnitudes and many changes in bin occupancy.

nearest_semantic_challenges.name: intraday_global_price_range_revisit_240m
nearest_semantic_challenges.relationship: both concern whether the price path explores or revisits prior territory
nearest_semantic_challenges.distinction: global revisit merges all high-low price intervals and is order invariant. Campaign083 reads close only and changes when the same close levels are permuted into a different record sequence.

nearest_semantic_challenges.name: intraday_bar_direction_continuity_238p
nearest_semantic_challenges.relationship: persistent candle direction may generate repeated close records
nearest_semantic_challenges.distinction: body continuity uses open-to-close signs and adjacent same-sign pairs with a support threshold. Campaign083 reads no open and can record a new frontier after an opposite-sign or zero-body arrangement.

nearest_semantic_challenges.name: intraday_range_amount_peak_timing_alignment_240m
nearest_semantic_challenges.relationship: both retain timing structure while discarding many magnitudes
nearest_semantic_challenges.distinction: Campaign082 scores the distance between one range maximum and one amount maximum. Campaign083 reads neither high/low nor amount and counts all strict sequential close-frontier innovations with no global-peak alignment.

nearest_semantic_challenges.name: signal_day_turnover_rate_pct
nearest_semantic_challenges.relationship: both could correlate with market attention
nearest_semantic_challenges.distinction: Campaign079 is a terminal daily turnover-level semantic duplicate; Campaign083 is a close-only ordinal path statistic and never reads daily_basic.

nearest_semantic_challenges.name: intraday_cross_sectional_standardized_return_state_stability_236p
nearest_semantic_challenges.relationship: the structurally nonnumeric definition remains in the complete semantic library
nearest_semantic_challenges.distinction: peer-standardized return-state mobility versus single-stock strict close-frontier innovation topology

nearest_semantic_challenges.name: candidate49_intraday_cumulative_vwap_crossing_rate_240m_v1
nearest_semantic_challenges.relationship: the sole active prospective candidate remains an isolation challenge
nearest_semantic_challenges.distinction: Candidate49 counts future-session sign crossings around causal cumulative VWAP. Campaign083 uses historical close running records only and never enters Candidate49 ledgers.
